reader.requirement: At 85 a format 1 VALUE in an entry that contains an OCCURS clause, or is subordinate to one at any depth, assigns the value to every occurrence of the item.

edition-consulted.switches: DialectLevel >= 2023 for figurative ZERO on a numeric-edited item (zero-fill below 2023, per §1985:VI.5.15.4 GR1c)

reader.edition-search: grep DialectLevel/Edition/ConstructRegistry in GroupImageCodec.cs and ValueInitializer.cs: only InitializerFrom/EditedImageOfNumericValue (numeric-edited ZERO). No edition test on the occurrence replication.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no for replication (2023 adds the format 2 table VALUE, not writable at 85)
reader.witnesses-cover: part: pb577 G91/G92 cover an elementary OCCURS and one level of subordination; a group VALUE on an OCCURS group, two-dimensional nesting, COMP, signed and BWZ elements are added by the probes

probes.expected: group VALUE per occurrence; every cell of a 2x3 table; COMP ZERO; ALL literal; BWZ item VALUE "07" in each occurrence

citations.check: OK  §1985:VI.5.15.6 GR6  (5.15.6 Data Description Entries Other Than Condition-Names)  the text is in GR6

reader.notes: Each occurrence's initializer comes from the same VALUE recipe (ElementInit per subscript, the group image per occurrence run), so every occurrence carries it; no edition-specific arm on this path.
